title: Harnessing ketones as hydrogen acceptors for atom-efficient upgrading of oxygenates to fuels over H/ZSM-5
content:

Jacob H. Miller, Caleb A. Coatney, Udishnu Sanyal, Karthikeyan K. Ramasamy, Hieu A. Doan, Rajeev S. Assary, Anh T. To, Cody J. Wrasman
Heterogeneous mixtures of bio-derived oxygenates are promising feedstocks for synthetic aviation fuel (SAF), but conversion strategies for one common component—short-chain (C5–7) internal ketones—are lacking.
